title: Case 033: Transactions export
initial_request: I need a CSV export of my transactions from 6 May through 9 May 2025 for my own budgeting. The export screen is unclear, and I want to know when the file is available in my secure portal.
overview: Mara Ellison, a verified H&V account holder, requested a CSV export for 6–9 May 2025 and escalated because the secure-portal export process was unclear. H&V requested the permitted export for her secure portal and made the resulting file available there. Whether the file works with any third-party accounting software has not been checked.

next_action.summary: Request the data service to create the permitted CSV export for the verified owner's secure portal, limited to the requested period.

outcome: The file transactions-033.csv is available in Mara's secure portal for 6–9 May 2025. Third-party accounting software compatibility remains unverified.

events.body: I’m requesting a CSV export of my transactions from 6 May through 9 May 2025 for my own budgeting. I’m not sure how to tell whether the export has been created.
I’m escalating this because the export process is unclear to me. Please let me know when the file for that period is available in my secure portal.

I’ve confirmed the authenticated profile and the customer’s secure-portal request. Please create the permitted CSV export for the verified account holder’s secure portal, covering 6–9 May 2025 only; do not send the data to a third party.
Export created for the requested period and made available for placement in the customer’s secure portal.
Your CSV export for 6–9 May 2025 is available in your secure portal as transactions-033.csv.
